next.offer_received: Compare the offers on your task and book the one that fits. You're only charged when you book.
next.offer_updated: Check the new price and time before you book.
next.offer_declined: Find work has other tasks near you.
next.booking_confirmed: Everything about it, including the chat with the other person, is on the booking page.
next.booking_canceled: The booking page says what happens next, including any refund.
next.helper_on_the_way: Follow along and message them from the booking page.
next.helper_running_late: If the new time doesn't work, message them from the booking page.
next.cant_access: Message them from the booking page so they can get in.
next.work_submitted: Check the photos, then approve or report a problem.
next.work_approved: Your earnings are on their way.
next.problem_reported: Talk it through on the booking page. Support can step in if you can't sort it out together.
next.earnings_transferred: They go to your bank account on your usual payout schedule.
next.payout_paid: It can take a business day to show in your bank account.
next.review_published: Reviews help neighbors choose with confidence.
next.message_received: Reply in the app. Contact details stay hidden until a booking is confirmed.
next.support_replied: Read the reply and answer on the case page.
next.case_resolved: The case page has the outcome.
next.change_proposed: Accept or decline the change from the booking page.
next.change_applied: The booking page shows the new details.
next.invite_received: Accept it, decline it, or suggest a different price or time.
next.invite_countered: Accept the counteroffer or reply with your own.
next.invite_accepted: It's booked. The details are on the booking page.
next.rebook_proposed: Accept and pay to book it, or decline.
next.rebook_accepted: It's booked. The details are on the booking page.
next.task_reopened: The client is looking for a new helper. Send an offer if you're free.
next.booking_reminder: Check the time and the details on the booking page.
next.verification_passed: Your setup page shows what is left before you can send offers.
next.verification_action_needed: Open your setup page to see what is needed. It only takes a few minutes.
next.background_check_expiring: Renewing keeps your in-home categories open without a gap.
next.id_expiring: Take photos of a current ID. Your current check counts until the end of your ID's expiry month.
next.helper_ready: Find work shows open tasks near you. Your first offer is a tap away.
next.task_match: Have a look and send an offer if it suits you. Turn these emails off on your account page any time.
next.data_export_ready: Download it from your account page within 7 days. After that it's deleted, and you can ask for a new copy any time.
next.tip_received: All of it is yours. It goes out with your next payout.
next.series_started: The next visits are on the calendar. Each is charged to their card 2 days before.
next.series_visit_skipped: The visits after it are on the calendar as usual.
next.series_paused: The visits in between are skipped. Nothing is charged for them.
next.series_resumed: The next visits are on the calendar again.
next.scheduled_payment_failed: Pay on the booking page, or change the card. We try again before then.
next.replacement_needed: Their helper canceled, so the time is set and the client is ready to book.
next.replacement_search_started: You were refunded in full. New offers will appear on your task. If you no longer need it, cancel the task.
next.badge_earned: See all your badges, and the next ones, on your account page.
next.city_open: Choose your neighborhood and add your home address. Then you can send offers on tasks near you.
next.reward_earned: Our team gives it a quick check, then you pick the card you want. Gift cards are separate from your earnings.
next.reward_ready: Pick the card you want on your Rewards page and redeem it within 90 days.
next.community_reply: Read the answer, and pin the one that helped.
next.community_helpful: See the conversation in the community.

checked.question: How are helpers checked?
checked.answer: Before sending offers, every helper verifies their phone, a government ID with a live selfie, and their home address. Clients see a badge with the date of each check.
checked.inHome: Before sending offers, every helper verifies their phone, a government ID with a live selfie, and their home address. This service happens in your home, so helpers also need a cleared background check before they can take it.

remote.question: Can it be done remotely?
remote.answer: Yes. Post it as a remote task: your helper works with you by screen sharing, and you keep control of your device and your passwords.
